title: Can I Still Go?
summary: After the collision, the flight to Abu Dhabi stopped on the runway.
content:
The Etihad flight I’m on has been sitting on the Incheon Airport runway for an hour and a half. I checked CNN breaking news on my laptop. "US and Israel attack Iran; Tehran retaliates across Middle East." Breaking news is appearing on Twitter saying that bombs have fallen on a U.S. military base in the city where I’m supposed to land.

The plane is still waiting to depart for Abu Dhabi. The moment a war begins is always sudden. The sky outside is still beautiful, quiet, and knows nothing.
🙏23❤12
